text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A new year has begun, and it's time for
Kawakami
Princess and I to take on her
classic year...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Sniffle!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Princess Fighter episode thirty-eight just gets me every time!

text_block_list.name: Dark Princess
text_block_list.text:
"You have no idea how many dreams I've

snatched away..."

text_block_list.name: Princess Fighter
text_block_list.text:
"Then you must make amends by
supporting
others all you can! It's not
too late!"

text_block_list.name: Princess Fighter
text_block_list.text:
"You don't need to envelop the world in

darkness—you're already strong enough!
Just
think of the passionate battles that
might await
us..."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, what a beautiful scene! I want to
be just like
Princess Fighter one day!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Isn't it obvious?
choice_data_list: なんで君はこの部屋で見てるんだ……？
なんで貴方はこの部屋で見てるの……？
choice_data_list_en: Why are you watching from this room...?
Why are you watching from this room...?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year! I came to wish you all
the—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hwah?! T-Trainer! I remember you said
you did
some studying before...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
B-b-but that disc over there... Is that
from the
first-generation Princess Fighter
box set?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ohhhh! Awesome! Do we get to start the
new year
watching Princess Fighter?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...And so we agreed to watch it together!
Did you
forget? That was only three
hours ago, you know.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
But if I keep going at this rate, I might
finish
watching all of it... Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's go out! ♪ Don't forget your
wallet
and phone.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Isn't it obvious?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Behold! Here they have the final episode
of
Princess Fighter, the movie, and even
the latest
series!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what's with that lukewarm
reaction? Let's
hurry and decide which
episodes to rent!
choice_data_list: やっぱりこうきたかー
choice_data_list_en: I had a feeling it'd go like this~

text_block_list.name: Monitor
text_block_list.text: "After all... I'm a princess!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Wooow! There's that famous line! So...
awesome!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Heh, but of course! I learned everything
I know
about princesses from this show!
It's no
exaggeration to say it changed
my whole life!
choice_data_list: 君は本当にプリファイが好きだね
貴方は本当にプリファイが好きだね
choice_data_list_en: You really do love Prifie, don't you?
You really love PreFie, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A princess is full of spunk and bravery,
but
blessed with the dignity and grace
to show mercy
to her enemies. ♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
You know, now that I think about it,
King could
totally be a Princess Fighter
heroine herself. A
first-rate Princess
Fighter with an unbreakable
will.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Gasp! Y-you're right! Which one should we pick, Trainer?
choice_data_list: ところでレンタルするんじゃなかったのか？
ところでレンタルするんじゃなかったの？
choice_data_list_en: By the way, weren't you going to rent it?
By the way, weren't you going to rent it?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I've seen them all, so I'll leave the choice
up to
you. Just go with your gut. ♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: AWE-SOME choice! Ahhh, you've got great taste, Trainer!
choice_data_list: 極限までスピードを極めるプリファイ45話
癒やされる最新プリファイのライブ映像
必殺技が魅力の劇場版
choice_data_list_en: Pre-Fie Episode 45: Pushing Speed to the Absolute Limit
Soothing concert footage of the latest Pre-Fi
The movie version that's all about the special moves.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's hurry back. We're going
to spend
the entire day indulging in
Princess Fighter
goodness!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, I spend the whole day watching
Princess
Fighter with Kawakami Princess.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I-is that the video that just released
recently? The
one that isn't even
available for rental? The one
that's
priced well beyond the average
student's
budget?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ohhhhh, you're so right!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Okay, go buy that—I mean, would you
please buy
it so we can watch it
together?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterwards, Kawakami Princess's eyes
sparkle with
boundless joy as we watch
the concert footage
together.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! I see, I see! So that's your
decision, eh?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: An excellent choice indeed. Now then...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Let's get the first movie, the Stars movie,
the
Versus movie,  the first All-Stars
movie, the P♭
movie, the second
All-Stars movie, and...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess continues to list title
after
title...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looks like my lunch breaks will be taken
up by
Princess Fighter movies for the
foreseeable
future...
